question: What are major new advanced findings(novelty ) from polarization-sensitive Optical coherence tomography from traditional OCT

ingredients.name: answer_critical_0
ingredients.criterion: The answer establishes that PS-OCT's novelty stems from adding polarization-sensitive detection to traditional OCT, framing all other advances as consequences of this capability.
examples: PS-OCT integrates polarization sensitivity into OCT, a capability traditional OCT lacks
The key new development is the incorporation of polarization-sensitive detection

ingredients.name: answer_critical_1
ingredients.criterion: The answer states that PS-OCT provides better contrast and differentiation of retinal layers than traditional OCT, enabling earlier and more accurate detection of retinal pathologies.
examples: Superior retinal layer contrast compared to traditional OCT
Better contrast and layer differentiation facilitate earlier, more accurate detection

ingredients.name: answer_critical_2
ingredients.criterion: The answer notes that PS-OCT can detect finer structural details and subtle pathological changes that conventional OCT systems may miss.
examples: Detection of subtle pathological changes that traditional OCT might overlook
Finer structural details visible with PS-OCT but missed by conventional systems

ingredients.name: answer_critical_3
ingredients.criterion: The answer identifies improved tissue characterization, including microstructure, as a major novelty enabled by polarization sensitivity.
examples: Polarization sensitivity improves tissue characterization
PS-OCT characterizes tissue microstructure in ways conventional OCT cannot

ingredients.name: answer_critical_4
ingredients.criterion: The answer describes a single-input PS-OCT system capable of depth-resolved imaging of collagen organization at varying depths.
examples: Single-input PS-OCT system for depth-resolved collagen imaging
Imaging collagen structures at varying depths

ingredients.name: answer_critical_5
ingredients.criterion: The answer states that PS-OCT can visualize and quantify collagen fiber orientations and densities, linking this to understanding fibrotic processes and tissue remodeling in various diseases.
examples: Accurate quantification of collagen fiber orientations and densities
Essential for studying fibrosis and tissue remodeling across multiple diseases

ingredients.name: valuable_0
ingredients.criterion: The answer situates the advances in the context of diagnosing and monitoring choroidal and retinal disorders.
examples: Tailored for diagnosing and monitoring choroidal and retinal disorders
Clinical relevance to retinal disease management

ingredients.name: valuable_1
ingredients.criterion: The answer indicates that collagen imaging and tissue characterization apply to various diseases beyond the eye, including fibrotic and remodeling conditions.
examples: Applicable to various diseases involving fibrotic processes
Tissue remodeling studies across multiple disease contexts

ingredients.name: valuable_2
ingredients.criterion: The answer explicitly frames findings as novelties relative to traditional/conventional OCT rather than listing PS-OCT features in isolation, ideally grounded in recent reviews of OCT developments.
examples: Compared to traditional OCT, PS-OCT offers...
Recent reviews highlight polarization sensitivity as a key new OCT development

ingredients.name: valuable_3

Latest developments in OCT technology include PS-OCT
